audience: pair-private: the giver's and the recipient's own open private sheets (the composer, the inbox, the ledger); loaded whole on every player phone

assets.name: pr-band
assets.about: A card's header band, stretched to the card's width; the icon and the title go over it.

assets.name: pr-envelope
assets.about: The offer in transit: sending, waiting for an answer, and arriving.

assets.name: pr-icon-promise
assets.about: The tray mark for Promises, beside the ledger's entry.

assets.name: pr-kind-captain-support
assets.about: Captain Support: a ballot slip with a captain's star.

assets.name: pr-kind-officer-selection
assets.about: Officer Selection: the public office's shield with two chevrons (never a secret role's mark).

assets.name: pr-kind-jail-vote
assets.about: Jail Vote: the barred window with a ballot going in.

assets.name: pr-kind-no-jail-vote
assets.about: No Jail Vote: the barred window refused (a ring and bar), the ballot held outside.

assets.name: pr-kind-meet-a
assets.about: Meet in A: an arched door, two heads at its threshold; the room letter is page text on its plate.

assets.name: pr-kind-meet-b
assets.about: Meet in B: a square door with a transom, two heads at its threshold; the room letter is page text on its plate.

assets.name: pr-seal-pending
assets.about: Pending: an open amber ring and an hourglass.

assets.name: pr-seal-fulfilled
assets.about: Fulfilled: a green seal with a check.

assets.name: pr-seal-not-fulfilled
assets.about: Not fulfilled: a plain grey seal with a bar (never a cross; it is not proof of a lie).

assets.name: pr-seal-condition-not-met
assets.about: Condition not met: a dashed, empty ring (the opportunity did not happen).
